findings.description: Three validator-owned integration tests do not reach or correctly assess their intended safeguards against the captured current builder dependency. One assumes a missing issues key; two require a target directory before their callback has created it.
findings.user_impact: The documented regression suite cannot pass against this dependency, and these failure-path safety scenarios are not qualified.
findings.proposed_correction: Make failure-record assertions explicit for the selected authoring contract and construct an existing target for competing-write/read-failure scenarios. Preserve mutation, no-baseline, evidence-retention and error-reason assertions. Pin the dependency identity.
preserved_requirements: No target or dependency repair during validation
